subject: Add category + tags to tasks/notes + tag-overlap gate feature (embed title+category+tag)
description: User thesis: enrich RAG with structured, churn-resistant targeting. Add category + tags fields to task and note nodes; embed title+category+tag (not just label/summary); add a tag/category-overlap feature to the gate (task.tags ∩ note.tags) as a stable signal robust to prose churn. NEEDS DESIGN PASS before build: where tags originate (author-set? auto-derived?), how the embedding combines fields, schema/overlay changes, and how the gate feature integrates. Strategic value: makes the learned gate churn-resistant (Layer 2 of note-mqbbndrgd1k).
